method: Readiness profile by discipline. Each cell has a status and the evidence it rests on: row ids in this folder's tables (pl-, dim-, uo-, ai-) or a row of the archive-pair table in scripts/archive_readiness_figures.py (pair:<row>). No number is typed here; figures and the report read values from the cited rows. Status rule: 'measured' = at least one cited row with a value read in the source text that applies to this discipline directly; 'partial' = only proxy, secondary, small-sample or qualitative evidence; 'not found' = searched on 2026-10-30 and recorded as not found; 'not assessed' = no search made for this cell. Cells are never summed or weighted into a score. For the 'Published AI results' column, measured = at least one sourced success and one sourced limitation; partial = one side only.
